input.rationale: The Agreement contains no limitation of liability, aggregate cap, or exclusion of indirect/consequential damages anywhere: Sections 1–5 (services, fees, term, site management), Section 8 (confidentiality), Section 9 (warranties) and Section 10 (general provisions) are silent, and searches for "liability", "consequential damages", "indemnif" and "aggregate/exceed" return only the no-joint-venture language in 10.2. Both parties are therefore fully exposed with no carve-out architecture, so the rule's clause is missing rather than merely deviating. We insert the shortest preferred-level clause after Section 9(b): a mutual cap at the greater of twelve months' fees paid or payable by the Company and USD 1,000,000, a mutual exclusion of indirect and consequential damages, uncapped Excluded Claims (confidentiality, data protection and security, indemnification, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud, infringement of the other Party's IP), and confirmation that the Company's payment obligations are not capped damages.

ops.text: Except for Excluded Claims, each Party's total aggregate liability arising out of or relating to this Agreement shall not exceed the greater of (i) the fees paid or payable by the Company under this Agreement in the twelve (12) months preceding the claim and (ii) One Million Dollars ($1,000,000), and neither Party shall be liable to the other for any indirect or consequential damages. The Company's payment obligations under this Agreement are not damages subject to the foregoing cap. "Excluded Claims" means a Party's breach of its confidentiality obligations, its breach of its data protection or security obligations, its indemnification obligations, its gross negligence, wilful misconduct or fraud, and its infringement of the other Party's intellectual property rights.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] The Agreement has no limitation of liability at all, so we added our standard mutual cap at the greater of twelve months' fees and USD 1,000,000 with a mutual exclusion of indirect and consequential damages. Confidentiality, data protection and security, indemnification, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud and IP infringement sit outside the cap, and the Company's payment obligations are not capped damages.
proposal.summary: Insert a mutual liability cap with uncapped excluded claims after Section 9(b)

mappings.element: The aggregate liability cap applies mutually to both parties.
The cap is the greater of fees paid or payable in the 12 months preceding the claim and USD 1,000,000.
The exclusion of indirect and consequential damages applies mutually to both parties.
Breach of confidentiality obligations is uncapped.
Breach of data protection and security obligations is uncapped.
Infringement of the other party's intellectual property is uncapped.
Customer payment obligations are excluded from damages subject to the cap.
